description: Edit the lines of a DRAFT purchase order (status created) the way the Purchase Orders page's Save does: add lines (addLines — itemSku or itemId + quantity, optional unitCost; an omitted cost is priced from the vendor's price book, then the item's catalog cost, then its last purchase), change lines (updateLines — the line's id or its SKU, plus a new quantity and/or unitCost), and remove lines (removeLineIds — line ids, or SKUs on exactly one line). Lines you do not name stay as they are. Line ids come from get_purchase_order_receiving. An order that was already issued, is awaiting approval or is further along cannot be edited here. The preview lists the resulting lines, what is added, changed and removed, and the new total; its receipt is bound to the order's current state, so an edit landing in between rejects the commit. Saving gives every line a new id. Max 500 resulting lines.

addLines.description: Lines to add (each itemSku or itemId + quantity, optional unitCost/expense).

expense.description: Optional line-level extra charge (shipping/handling), added to the line total. Defaults to the price book's setup cost when the book priced the line, else 0.

itemId.description: Item id (GUID) to order — the alternative to itemSku. Provide exactly one of the two.

itemSku.description: Item SKU to order. Provide exactly one of itemSku or itemId. Resolved against the tenant's catalog (a client-pinned token only resolves its own client's items).

quantity.description: REQUIRED. Quantity to order (must be greater than zero).

unitCost.description: Agreed unit cost for this line. Omit to price it from the vendor's active price book at this quantity, else the item's catalog cost, else its last purchase cost; the preview names the source.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive the resulting lines plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

purchaseOrder.description: Purchase order id (GUID) or document number (e.g. PO-1042).

removeLineIds.description: Existing lines to remove: line ids (GUIDs) or SKUs on exactly one line.

updateLines.description: Existing lines to change, by line id or SKU.

line.description: The line to change: its lineId (GUID, from get_purchase_order_receiving lines[].lineId) or the item SKU when that SKU is on exactly one line of the order.

quantity.description: New quantity (greater than zero). Omit to keep the current quantity.

unitCost.description: New unit cost (zero or more). Omit to keep the current cost.

name: update_purchase_order_lines
title: Update Purchase Order Lines
